consultation.linkedEvidence.title: Source-linked clinical note
consultation.linkedEvidence.subtitle: Deterministic projection built only from clinical facts linked to the FINAL transcript. Every item can be traced back to its evidence.
consultation.linkedEvidence.emptyHelp: Continue the consultation or fact extraction. Nothing will be invented to fill this note.
consultation.linkedEvidence.audioRetenti: Raw audio is not retained after ACK under the current policy. The timestamp and FINAL transcript quote remain available as evidence.
consultation.linkedEvidence.validationSa: Any change to the FINAL transcript or clinical facts creates a new version and requires a new medical validation.
consultation.linkedEvidence.validationSu: This version of the source-linked note has been validated.
consultation.linkedEvidence.validationFa: Validation could not be saved. The note remains unvalidated.
consultation.linkedEvidence.stale: The note changed since you last reviewed it.
consultation.linkedEvidence.staleHelp: Joprelys reloaded the current version. Review the changed items before validating again.
consultation.linkedEvidence.sourceChange: Evidence changed while the note was being built.
consultation.linkedEvidence.forbidden: You are not authorized to access this source-linked note.
consultation.linkedEvidence.loadFailed: The source-linked clinical note could not be loaded.
consultation.linkedEvidence.loadErrorHel: The manual consultation remains available. Refresh after the service recovers; no clinical data is auto-filled when this feature fails.
